## Summary

Drain the fuel tank before replacing the in-tank or inline filter. [t2016]

## Parts

- [Partial] Fuel Filter: Common auto part, costs around $20 [t2016]

## Tips & gotchas

- Expect a messy job as the old filter may leak fuel everywhere. [t2016]
- Use a specialized tool to separate hoses from nozzles if standard removal is difficult. [t2016]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Changing the filter without draining the tank first, leading to excessive dripping and mess. [t2016]
